retraction.reason: Retracted in M21 as outside the atlas: this is FRENCH Guinea — Conakry, not Bissau — and the import caught it on a class query rather than on any Portuguese connection. The cached lead is one sentence giving a date. The one thing French Guinea does for this atlas happens in 1958 and is wired there.
